beats.text: Five things quietly wasting your potential — without you noticing.
One. Waiting for the perfect moment. It never arrives. The people who win just start messy.
Two. Consuming endlessly instead of creating. Watching others build is not building.
Three. Keeping every option open forever. Potential needs a commitment to pour itself into.
Four. Surrounding yourself with low expectations. You rise or sink to the room you're in.
Five. Mistaking being busy for being productive. Motion feels like progress, but it isn't.
Potential isn't lost in one big failure. It leaks away in small, comfortable habits. Plug the leaks.

source_note: Which leak will you plug first?
